correctness.rationale: The state-dependent mixed likelihood follows exactly from transition density p dy on a strict decrease and mass 1-px on a stay. An iid uniform minimum coupling proves record-count growth and square summability; the score is a bounded-increment martingale with predictable variance asymptotic to log n/p². Uniform local observed curvature yields LAN and the unique interior MLE with Gaussian efficiency. Terminal information follows from the known atom-plus-density formula via dominated convergence. 111 exact rational program checks passed, serving as finite diagnostics only.

value.rationale: An unaddressed, naturally motivated statistical inference problem for the new state-dependent stochastic model has only logarithmic cumulative information although n time points are observed. The sharp path-versus-endpoint separation and efficient estimator identify the effective information horizon and inform experimental observation design. This is a genuine nonstationary parametric limit theorem, not simply a transformation of a published marginal law.
